1. About Linq

Linq is a multi-vendor digital loyalty platform that lets Members (customers) collect stamps and stickers at participating businesses and lets Vendors (businesses) run digital loyalty programmes. The app includes stamp cards, collectible sticker sets, daily and monthly challenges, leaderboards, in-app messaging, pixel avatars, and a prize draw system.

Linq is operated by Adastra Network. Our contact email is info@adastranetwork.co.uk.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 13 years old to create a Member account. You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal authority to bind a business to use Linq as a Vendor. By creating an account you confirm you meet these requirements.

3. Your account

You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. You must provide accurate, current, and complete information when registering and keep it up to date.

Notify us immediately at info@adastranetwork.co.uk if you suspect unauthorised access to your account. We are not liable for losses caused by unauthorised use of your credentials.

You may not create more than one personal account or create accounts on behalf of others without their consent.

Members

4. Stamp cards & rewards

When you join a Vendor's loyalty programme, a digital stamp card is created for you. Stamps are issued by the Vendor via NFC tap or QR code scan at the point of visit.

Rewards (e.g. a free coffee, a discount) are defined entirely by each Vendor and may be changed, reduced, or withdrawn at any time at the Vendor's discretion. We do not guarantee the availability, nature, or value of any reward. Rewards have no cash value unless explicitly stated by the Vendor.

To receive a reward you must present your stamp card to the Vendor in-app. Linq accepts no liability for Vendor failure to honour a reward.

Members

5. Sticker collections & prizes

Stamps and completed challenges earn you collectible digital stickers. Stickers are categorised by rarity tier: yellow, orange, blue, purple, and gold (legendary). Collecting sticker sets may enter you into monthly prize draws.

Prize draws are subject to separate rules published in-app at the time of each draw. We reserve the right to amend prize pool values, draw schedules, eligibility criteria, and prize fulfilment at any time with reasonable notice. Prizes have no cash alternative unless stated. You must claim prizes within the timeframe specified or they will be forfeited.

Stickers are in-app collectibles with no monetary value. They cannot be transferred, sold, exchanged, or redeemed for cash.

Members

6. Challenges & games

Linq features time-limited challenges and in-app games including but not limited to Linqle (a daily word game), Daily Vote, City Explorer, and Streak Master. Challenge availability, scoring rules, and associated rewards may change at any time.

Streak bonuses are awarded based on consecutive valid completions. We are not liable for lost streaks caused by technical faults, connectivity issues, or app downtime, though we will make reasonable efforts to restore streaks affected by platform-side errors.

Members

7. Pixel avatar & daily wheel

Each account has a pixel avatar — a customisable in-app representation. Avatar items are earned through stamp milestones, challenges, and the daily spin wheel. Avatar items have no monetary value and cannot be transferred, sold, or exchanged between accounts.

The daily spin wheel may be used once per 24-hour period. We reserve the right to change, retire, or modify avatar items, the wheel prize pool, and the frequency rules at any time.

Members

8. Leaderboards & social features

Leaderboards display your display name and stamp count relative to other users. By using Linq you consent to this information being visible to other users on leaderboards. You can update your display name in Settings at any time.

In-app messages you send to a Vendor are visible to that Vendor and their staff. Do not share sensitive personal information in messages.

You are solely responsible for the content of any messages, posts, or reviews you submit. We reserve the right to remove content that violates these Terms or applicable law.

Vendors

9. Registering a business

To register a business on Linq you must provide accurate business details including business name, registered address or trading address, country, and contact information. You warrant that you have the legal authority to bind the business to these Terms.

Your business listing, including name, logo, location, and loyalty programme details, will be visible to all Linq users. You are responsible for ensuring all business information is accurate and kept up to date.

Vendors

10. Issuing stamps

Stamps must only be issued for genuine customer visits or qualifying purchases as defined in your loyalty programme. You are responsible for ensuring your staff issue stamps appropriately.

Abuse of the stamp-issuance system — including issuing stamps without a genuine qualifying transaction, bulk self-stamping, or any form of fraudulent stamp issuance — may result in your account being suspended or permanently removed. We reserve the right to audit stamp activity.

Vendors

11. Right of refusal

Vendors retain the right to modify, suspend, or withdraw their loyalty programme at any time, including changing stamp thresholds and reward values. We ask that Vendors give reasonable in-app notice of material changes to their programme.

Members who have accumulated stamps on a programme that is subsequently withdrawn will be notified through the app. Linq does not guarantee that any specific reward will remain available.

Vendors

12. Vendor obligations

As a Vendor, you are responsible for:

  • The accuracy of your business listing, branding assets, and programme terms
  • Honouring rewards to Members who have legitimately earned them
  • Ensuring rewards and promotions comply with applicable law, including advertising standards, consumer protection legislation, and prize promotion regulations
  • Handling disputes with Members regarding your programme directly and in good faith
  • Ensuring any staff with access to the Vendor account understand and comply with these Terms

Linq is a platform provider only. We are not party to the loyalty agreement between you and your Members and accept no liability for your failure to fulfil rewards or obligations.

Vendors

13. Paid add-ons

Core loyalty card features are free for Vendors. Certain additional features — such as push offers, advanced analytics, challenge participation, and subscription card programmes — may be available as paid add-ons.

Pricing, billing cycles, and cancellation policies for paid add-ons are presented at the point of purchase. Fees may be updated with reasonable advance notice. Refunds for paid add-ons are provided at our discretion except where required by law.
